title: Anastasia Simes
seoTitle: Anastasia Simes - Best Family Lawyer Sydney
description: Anastasia is arguably one of Sydney's best Family Lawyers who has practiced predominantly in Family Law for nearly 10 years.
html:
Anastasia Simes​

Partner

Anastasia is a skilled and empathetic Family Lawyer who has practiced in the area of Family Law for 11 years.

Anastasia is passionate about obtaining the best outcome while maintaining approachable relationships with her clients and colleagues.

Anastasia has experience in representing clients in complex financial matters, parenting matters and divorce applications. Anastasia takes a practical and meticulous approach to her matters.

Whilst Anastasia believes in exploring all avenues of fruitful negotiations and alternative dispute resolution before resorting to litigation, she has extensive Court experience.

Anastasia also has experience drafting wills and is pleased to be able to offer this service to her clients.

We are proud that Anastasia now heads up our Melbourne Family Law Practice, backed by the same team that has earned consecutive Doyle’s Guide recognition, with Accredited Family Law Specialists and lawyers holding Masters degrees in Applied Law (Family Law).

Together, we ensure our Melbourne clients receive Family Law advice that is technically rigorous, strategically sound, and litigation-ready from the outset.
